psalm_response: Amanzi omlambo ayavuisa umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu!
homily:
Cinga ngamanzi aphuma phantsi kwesango letempile, enqulwini ka-Ezekiyeli, ehamba kancinci kusasa ehla esiya ngasentshonalanga, eguqulela ulwandle olunetyuwa lube lulwelo oluhlambulukileyo. Asiyonto enkulu kwasekuqalekeni; ngumlambo omncane oqala ngengcongolo encinci emnyango wendlu kaThixo. Kodwa njengoko uhamba, wonke umthi obecaleni kwawo uqala ukuhluma, amagqabi asasaza ukuphilisa, kwaye ubomi buyavuka apho kwakusemkhuhlaneni nakulwandle olufileyo. Le yindlela uThixo asebenza ngayo. Akasoloko eza nenkanyamba okanye umlilo omkhulu; uqala ngamanzi amancinci ahlambululayo, kancinci kancinci, de aguqule yonke indawo ibe ntsha.

KwiNcwadi ka-Ezekiyeli namhlanje, sifunda ngaloo manzi aphuma ngaphantsi kwesango: "Wherever the river flows, every sort of living creature that can multiply shall live." Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Awunyanzelekanga ukuba uqonde yonke imida yolwandle ukuze ubone amandla kaThixo. Kwanele ukubona indlela amanzi aphilisa ngayo apho omileyo khona. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le ndlela yokusebenza. Ingqondo yakhe yayingeyiyo eyokuhlala engenamsebenzi; yayiyeyokwazi ukubala imigama emide, ukucinga ngendlela i-AI ne-cloud infrastructure e-AWS eziqhagamshela ngayo, nokuhlekisa ngale mibono yakhe emangalisayo ye-'con chim airlines' eyayimenza agcigcise futhi amomotheke xa ethetha ngayo nobawo wakhe. Kodwa ngaphaphi kwayo yonke loo nto, uBen wayeyazi ukuba ubomi bokwenyani buvela kuthando, kumthombo ongazange wome.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ungena ethempelini laseYerusalem, ebona ukuba indlu kaThixo iguqulelwe kwindawo yokuthengisa. Ubenza ikhola yezintambo, ekhaba phantsi ameta abashintshi bemali, esithi: "Take these out of here, and stop making my Father's house a marketplace." Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akabhaleli mthetho wokurhweba; ulwela ubungcwele bendawo yokuthandaza. Uphakamisa umzimba Wakhe njenge tempile entsha eyiNyaniso. UBen wayengumntwana owayephila njengendawo eyiyo yetempile kaThixo. Wayengumfana owayeneentliziyo ethambileyo, owayebonisa ububele obungagungqiyo kuwo wonke umntu. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu ezingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa. Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseKorinte namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela amazwi acacileyo: "Do you not know that you are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?" Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngezakhiwo zamatye okanye ngeendonga eziqinileyo kuphela. Uthetha ngomphefumlo womntu ngamnye, ngendlela uThixo ahlala ngayo phakathi kwethu. UBen wayengumfana owayengaphili nje ngemizimba yeli hlabathi; wayeyindawo yokuhlala uMoya oyingcwele. Indlela awayehlonipha ngayo abazali bakhe, indlela awayemomotheka ngayo xa wayesenza izinto ezintsha, kwakuyimbonakaliso yalo mthombo wamanzi aphilayo owaphuma ethempelini likaThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliCilekileyo leAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwezinto zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba uze emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiya kukwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndiyazibophelela kuwe ngokupheleleyo; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uxolo lukaThixo olugqithisa konke ukuqonda lungagcina iintliziyo zenu nengqondo zenu kuYesu Kristu. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin omncane kunye nabo bonke abaphumle kule minyaka idlulileyo bakhanyiselwe kukukhanya kukaKristu ngonaphakade, sikhuleke kwiNkosi.
Ukuze bonke abo basentslungwini yokulahlekelwa bafumane intuthuzelo nethemba eliphuma kuThixo, sikhuleke kwiNkosi.
readings: Ingelosi yandibuyisela ngaseMnyango wetempile, ndabona amanzi ephuma ngaphantsi kwesango letempile asinga ngasentshonalanga, kuba ubuso betempile babusingise ngasentshonalanga; amanzi ehla esuka ngasezantsi kwetempile, ngasezantsi kwesibingelelo. Wandikhokelela ngaphandle ngesango lasemntla, wandijikeleza ngesango langaphandle elisingise ngasentshonalanga, apho ndabona khona amanzi asuka ngasezantsi. Wathi kum: "La manzi aphuma asinga esiqiwini sasentshonalanga ehla asinga eArabah, aye kutshona ulwandle, amanzi anetyuwa, aze awenze abe msulwa. Kuwo onke amaqela apho uhamba khona umlambo, zonke izidalwa eziphilileyo ezinokuphindaphinda ziya kuphila, kuba kuya kuba nentlanzi eninzi, kuba naphi na apho afika khona la manzi, ulwandle luya kwenziwa lube msulwa. Ngapha nangapha komlambo kuya kula imithi yiziqokelelo zonke ziziqhamo; amagqabi ayo awasayi kubuna, nezihlo zayo azisayi kuphela. Nyanga zonke ziya kuvelisa iziqhamo ezitsha, kuba ziya kunkcenkceshelwa ngamanzi aphuma engcweleni. Ziqhamo zazo ziya kuba kukudla, namagqabi azo abe ngamayeza."

Amanzi omlambo ayavuisa umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu! UThixo uyisikhuselo sethu namandla ethu, uncedo olusemzuzwini weentslungu. Ngoko ke asoyiki, nokuba umhlaba ungazanyazanyiswa nezintaba zigingqikele enzulwini yolwandle. Amanzi omlambo ayavuisa umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu! Kukho ummoya oqukuqelayo owonwabisayo umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu. UThixo usembindini wawo; awusayi kushukunyiswa; uThixo uya kumnceda ekuseni kakhulu. Amanzi omlambo ayavuisa umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu! INkosi yamabutho inani; isikhuselo sethu nguThixo kaJakobi. Yizani! Bonani imisebenzi yeNkosi, izinto ezimangalisayo ezenzileyo emhlabeni. Amanzi omlambo ayavuisa umuzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yoOsesemphezulu!

Bazalwa bami: Niyisakhiwo sikaThixo. Ngokobabalo lukaThixo olunikiweyo kum, njengomakhi oqondayo ndabeka isiseko, omnye wakha phezu kwaso. Kodwa umntu ngamnye makalumkele indlela akha ngayo phezu kwaso, kuba akukho namnye onokubeka esinye isiseko esingaphezulu kwesikhoyo, esinguYesu Kristu. Anazi na ukuba niyitempile kaThixo, nokuba uMoya kaThixo uba ngaphakathi kwenu? Ukuba umntu utshabalalisa itempile kaThixo, uThixo uya kumtshabalalisa lowo; kuba itempile kaThixo, eniyiyo, ingcwele.

Njengoko umsitho wePasika yamaYuda wawusondele, uYesu wenyuka waya eJerusalem. Wafumana etempileni abo bathengisa ngeenkomo, ngeegusha, nangeehobe, kunye nabasebenzi bokutshintsha imali ababehlé apho. Wenza isikhwebu seentambo, wabaqhuba bonke abaphuma etempileni, kuhlanganise neegusha neenkomo, waphithizela imali yabasebenzi bokutshintsha, wajika iimeta zabo, wathi kwabathengisa ngeehobe: "Zisani ezi zinto apha, musani ukwenza indlu kaYise ibe ngumzi wokurhweba." Abafundi bakhe bakhumbula amazwi asEzahlukweni: "Ukuzabalazela indlu yakho kuyanditya." Kulapho amaYuda aphendula khona wathi kuye: "Uluphawu luni olusinika lona lokwenza le nto?" UYesu waphendula wathi kuwo: "Chitha le tempile, kwaye ngeentsuku ezintathu ndiya kuyiphakamisa." AmaYuda athi: "Le tempile yakhiwa iminyaka engamashumi amane anesithandathu, uya kuyiphakamisa ngeentsuku ezintathu na?" Kodwa wayethetha ngetempile yomzimba wakhe. Ngoko ke, xa wavuswa abafileyo, abafundi bakhe bakhumbula ukuba wayesitsho oku, baza bakholwa kwisizinda nakwelizwi elalithethwe nguYesu.

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
